| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Hue** `hue` | 0 | 0 to 360 deg | Center of the hue range on the color circle. 0 is red, 120 is green and 240 is blue. |
| **Hue width** `hueWidth` | 30 | 0 to 180 deg | How far the hue may be from the center on each side. 180 accepts every hue. |
| **Saturation from** `saturationMin` | 20 | 0 to 100 % | Lowest saturation that is fully selected. |
| **Saturation to** `saturationMax` | 100 | 0 to 100 % | Highest saturation that is fully selected. |
| **Value from** `valueMin` | 10 | 0 to 100 % | Lowest HSV value (the largest of R, G and B) that is fully selected. |
| **Value to** `valueMax` | 100 | 0 to 100 % | Highest HSV value that is fully selected. |
| **Softness** `softness` | 10 | 0 to 90 | Fade outside every range, in degrees for hue and percent for saturation and value. |
